params.name: format
params.description: Response format. JSON is the default for programmatic use.

params.name: no_html
params.description: Strip HTML from response text fields when set to 1.

params.name: skip_disambig
params.description: Skip disambiguation responses when set to 1.

params.name: no_redirect
params.description: Skip HTTP redirects for !bang queries; return the redirect URL in the body instead.

params.name: callback
params.description: JSON-P callback function name. When set, response is returned as JSON-P.

items.docs:
Returns the DuckDuckGo Instant Answer for the supplied query `q`.
For !bang queries (e.g. `!w filter bubble`) the response contains a
non-empty `Redirect` field pointing at the destination site's search
results. For topical queries, expect `Abstract*`, `RelatedTopics`,
and optionally `Image` / `Infobox`. Empty fields are normal when no
instant answer is available for the query.
